title: 已禁用因子无法计算独立指标 — factor_eligibility_service 默认过滤掉 disabled 因子
description: 因子独立指标计算入口 backend/services/factor_eligibility_service.py 默认 include_disabled=False，前端在请求时也未传 include_disabled:true。结果是已禁用因子无法触发独立指标计算流水线，影响因子库后续 cleanup / 复活决策。修复方向：(a) 后端默认改 include_disabled=True 并由 caller 显式传 False 来过滤；或 (b) 前端在 disabled 列表入口显式传 include_disabled:true。从 MEMORY pending_fixes.md 提取。
required_verification: Standalone metrics computed for known-disabled factor
Backward compatibility test for active-factor flow
closure_requirements: Decision recorded for default include_disabled value

events.note: Found during QE Official Eval Unification work
